name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and lift it out to above your chest.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
cues: Shoulder blades squeezed back and down
Feet planted, glutes stay on the bench
Breathe in as you lower, out as you press

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows flared straight out to the sides
common_mistakes.fix: Tuck elbows to about 45 degrees from your body

common_mistakes.mistake: Bouncing the bar off the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Lower slowly and touch the chest lightly
Keep glutes down and push through your feet

name: Push Ups
steps: Place hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulders, legs straight behind you.
Brace your body into one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest to just above the floor.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight again.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and brace your stomach
Lower until chest is a fist from the floor, or use an incline
Look at the floor just ahead of your hands

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit at the machine with thighs snug under the pads.
Grip the bar wider than shoulders, palms facing away.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
cues: Pull elbows down toward your hips
Breathe out as you pull down

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning far back and swinging the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and keep your torso still

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling the bar behind the neck
common_mistakes.fix: Always pull the bar to the front, to your upper chest

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the bar yank arms up fast
common_mistakes.fix: Control the bar all the way up

name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at the row station with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with arms straight and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Straighten your arms slowly to return, without rounding your back.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades at the end

common_mistakes.mistake: Rocking the torso back and forth
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your torso still; only the arms move

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the lower back on the return
common_mistakes.fix: Stop the stretch when your back starts to round

common_mistakes.mistake: Shrugging shoulders up to the ears
common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders down and pull with your back

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them to chest level.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Lower them slowly until elbows are just below the bench line.
Press back up, bringing the dumbbells close together at the top.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned to the bench
Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Stop when elbows are slightly below the bench
Keep forearms vertical through the whole rep
Keep a small natural arch, glutes on the bench

name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet hip width and hold the bar at the front of your shoulders.
Grip just wider than shoulders with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Brace your stomach and press the bar straight up over your head.
Lower the bar with control back to your shoulders.
cues: Move your head back, bar travels straight
Breathe in, brace, breathe out at top

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to push the bar up
common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and stomach; lower the weight

common_mistakes.mistake: Pressing the bar out in front
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the bar close to your face on the way up

common_mistakes.mistake: Flaring the elbows wide at the start
common_mistakes.fix: Start with elbows slightly forward of the bar

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Hold the bar with an overhand grip, hands just wider than your knees.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips until your torso is near 45 degrees.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar with control until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep the bar close to your legs

common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the load and keep your chest proud

common_mistakes.mistake: Standing up more with each rep
common_mistakes.fix: Hold the same hinge angle for the whole set

common_mistakes.mistake: Jerking the weight up with the hips
common_mistakes.fix: Use only the arms and back to move the bar

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight again.

common_mistakes.mistake: Twisting the torso to lift the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your chest facing the floor

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling to the chest instead of the hip
common_mistakes.fix: Drive the elbow back toward your back pocket
Brace the stomach and keep the spine long

name: Pull Ups
steps: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip a little wider than shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down and back to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang with straight arms.
cues: Breathe out as you pull up

common_mistakes.fix: Keep legs still; use a band if needed
Lower all the way to straight arms each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Reaching the chin forward to clear the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Pull your chest toward the bar, chin neutral

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, dumbbells resting on your thighs.
Lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press them up until your arms are straight over your head.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the back off the pad
common_mistakes.fix: Brace your stomach and use a lighter weight
Bring dumbbells down to about ear level

common_mistakes.mistake: Banging the dumbbells together at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Stop just short of touching at the top

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set a bench to a low incline, about 30 degrees.
Lie back with dumbbells at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your upper chest.
cues: Press up, not back over your face
Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Use a low incline so the chest does the work
Keep elbows about 45 degrees from your body

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the hips off the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Keep glutes down, feet pressing the floor

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees, eyes under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders and lift the bar out over your upper chest.
Lower the bar with control to your upper chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Bar touches high on the chest
Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.mistake: Bouncing the bar off the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Pause lightly at the chest, then press
Tuck elbows slightly toward your body
Lift the bar out slowly and settle before the first rep

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and lift it out over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.mistake: Bar landing too high on the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Lower the bar toward the bottom of your chest
Take two seconds to lower each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Sitting up quickly at the end
common_mistakes.fix: Rack the bar, then sit up slowly

name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells pressed up over your chest, palms facing in.
Keep a small, fixed bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc, squeezing your chest.
cues: Stop when upper arms reach chest level
Hug a big tree on the way up
Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.mistake: Bending the elbows into a press
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the same elbow angle throughout
Stop when arms are level with the bench

common_mistakes.mistake: Using weights that are too heavy
common_mistakes.fix: Pick a weight you can control at the bottom

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a bench set to a low incline with dumbbells over your upper chest.
Keep palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms wide until you feel a gentle chest stretch.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together.
cues: Control the bottom of the arc
Breathe out as you squeeze up

common_mistakes.fix: Hold the elbow angle fixed

common_mistakes.mistake: Dropping the arms below the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Stop at chest level

common_mistakes.mistake: Shoulders rolling forward at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulder blades pulled back

name: Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys high and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance and lean your chest slightly forward.
With elbows slightly bent, bring your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are out wide.
cues: Squeeze hands together at the end
Breathe out as you bring hands in

common_mistakes.mistake: Bending elbows to press the handles
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the same elbow bend throughout

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the cables pull arms back too far
common_mistakes.fix: Stop the return when arms are in line with your body

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning the whole body to move weight
common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and keep the torso still

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand in the middle with a slight forward stance and arms down at your sides.
Raise your hands up and together in front of your upper chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders down as hands rise
Stop when hands reach upper chest height
Stand still and move only the arms

name: Pec Deck Machine Fly
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your back flat on the pad.
Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Let them open back slowly until you feel a gentle chest stretch.
cues: Upper arms level with the floor

common_mistakes.fix: Return slowly and keep tension

common_mistakes.mistake: Going too far back on the stretch
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when hands are in line with your chest
Keep chest up and shoulder blades back

name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Sit with your back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly, stopping before the weight touches down.
cues: Back and head on the pad

common_mistakes.mistake: Seat set too low or high
common_mistakes.fix: Line the handles up with your mid-chest

common_mistakes.mistake: Shoulders rolling forward at the end
common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulder blades against the pad

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the weight crash between reps
common_mistakes.fix: Control the return every rep

name: Incline Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.
cues: Back on the pad, chest up
Smooth press, soft elbows at top

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the back off the pad
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your back flat and stomach tight
Use the full comfortable range each rep
Keep shoulders down away from your ears

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Set a flat bench under the bar so it lines up with your mid-chest.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders and twist the bar to unhook it.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest.
Press back up and twist to re-hook when finished.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.mistake: Bench placed in the wrong spot
common_mistakes.fix: Line the bar up with your mid-chest before starting

common_mistakes.mistake: Forgetting to set the safety stops
common_mistakes.fix: Set stops just below your chest height

common_mistakes.mistake: Bouncing the bar off the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Lower slowly and touch lightly

name: Incline Push Ups
steps: Place your hands on a bench or sturdy box, slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the edge.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and stomach
Use a fixed bench or a wall
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees

name: Decline Push Ups
steps: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulders.
Brace into a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Brace your stomach and squeeze glutes

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet set too high to start
common_mistakes.fix: Begin with a low step and progress
Keep your head in line with your body

name: Chest Dips
steps: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Lean your torso slightly forward and bend your knees.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Stop when upper arms are level
Breathe out as you push up

common_mistakes.fix: Stop when upper arms are parallel to the floor
Press shoulders down before each rep
Keep legs still and lower with control

name: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc until arms are in line with your ears.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
cues: Stop when arms reach ear level
Breathe in back, breathe out over

common_mistakes.fix: Keep ribs down and lower back on the bench

common_mistakes.mistake: Bending elbows like a triceps move
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the elbow angle the same

common_mistakes.mistake: Lowering too far behind the head
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when arms line up with your ears

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a V-handle to the pulldown cable and sit with thighs under the pads.
Hold the handle with palms facing each other and arms straight.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging the torso to move the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Keep torso still with a small lean
Pull until the handle nears your upper chest

common_mistakes.mistake: Arms yanked up at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Control the return to straight arms

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit at the pulldown with thighs under the pads.
Grip the bar shoulder width with palms facing you.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Let the bar rise slowly to the start.
cues: Squeeze your back at the bottom

common_mistakes.fix: Keep hands about shoulder width apart
Think about driving elbows to your hips
Keep only a small lean

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is close to 45 degrees, arms hanging.
Pull both dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades at the top

common_mistakes.fix: Keep chest proud and stomach braced
Hold the same hinge throughout
Lift and lower under control

name: Underhand Barbell Row
steps: Hold the bar with palms facing forward, hands about shoulder width.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward to about 45 degrees.
Pull the bar to your lower stomach, elbows close to your body.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Bar stays close to your legs

common_mistakes.mistake: Using the hips to heave the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Hold your torso still and use a lighter bar
Brace before each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Curling the bar with the biceps
common_mistakes.fix: Lead with the elbows, not the hands

name: T-Bar Row
steps: Straddle the bar and grab the handle near the plates.
Bend your knees and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pull the plates toward your chest, squeezing your back.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades at the top

common_mistakes.fix: Use fewer plates and keep chest up

common_mistakes.mistake: Standing up to lift the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Hold your hinge angle still
Lower until arms are straight each rep

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down with your chest on the pad.
Let a dumbbell hang in each hand, arms straight.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the chest off the pad
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your chest down and move only the arms
Pull elbows back, not shoulders up
Lower all the way to straight arms

name: Seated Machine Row
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull the handles toward your body, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep your chest in contact with the pad
Keep shoulders down as you pull
Control the return every rep

name: Chin Ups
steps: Hang from a bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder width.
Pull your shoulders down to start.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
cues: Breathe out as you pull up

common_mistakes.fix: Keep legs still; use a band if needed
Return to straight arms each rep
Keep shoulders packed down

name: Band-Assisted Pull Ups
steps: Loop a resistance band over the pull-up bar and secure it.
Grip the bar and place a knee or foot in the band.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cues: Breathe out as you pull up

common_mistakes.mistake: Bouncing out of the bottom on the band
common_mistakes.fix: Pause briefly at the bottom of each rep
Use a box and keep a firm grip as you step in
Lower to straight arms every rep

name: Inverted Row
steps: Set a bar in a rack at about waist height.
Hang underneath it with hands wider than shoulders and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and keep a straight line

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling the chin to the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Pull your chest to the bar instead

common_mistakes.mistake: Bar set too low to start
common_mistakes.fix: Raise the bar or bend your knees to make it easier

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley holding a straight bar, arms out in front.
Hinge slightly forward with soft knees and nearly straight arms.
Sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly back to eye level.
cues: Squeeze your lats at the bottom
Breathe out as you pull down

common_mistakes.mistake: Bending the elbows into a pushdown
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the elbows only slightly bent

common_mistakes.mistake: Rocking the body to move the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Hold your torso still

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the bar go too high
common_mistakes.fix: Stop around eye level

name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope on a cable at upper chest to face height.
Hold the rope ends with palms facing in and step back with arms straight.
Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends apart.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Pull the rope apart at your face

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to move the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and stand tall
Keep elbows at shoulder height
Aim the rope at your nose or forehead

name: Scapular Pull Ups
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Your body rises a few centimetres; pause briefly.
Slowly let your shoulders rise back to a relaxed hang.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms straight; only the shoulders move
Keep legs still and core tight
Lower slowly to the relaxed position

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet hip width and dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

common_mistakes.fix: Brace your stomach and lighten the load

common_mistakes.mistake: Using the legs to bounce the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Keep knees still unless doing a push press
Bring the dumbbells to about ear level

name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support holding dumbbells at chest height, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with arms straight over your head.
Lower slowly, rotating palms back to face you.

common_mistakes.fix: Turn the palms slowly through the press
Keep your back on the pad
Pick a lighter weight than your normal press

name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height.
Sit with your back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
cues: Smooth press, soft elbows at top

common_mistakes.mistake: Seat too low, handles too high
common_mistakes.fix: Set handles level with your shoulders
Keep your back and head on the pad
Control the return every rep

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to your sides.

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and lift slowly
Stop when arms are level with your shoulders
Keep your neck long and shoulders down

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle with your far hand.
Hold the machine with your free hand for support.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly back across your body.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning away to cheat the weight up
common_mistakes.fix: Stay upright and use a lighter weight
Keep shoulder down
Lower over two seconds

name: Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows, arms at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.

common_mistakes.mistake: Band too tight to finish the rep
common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter band or step wider apart

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the band snap arms down
common_mistakes.fix: Lower slowly
Stand tall and still

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.

common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the weight and stand still
Stop at shoulder height
Keep a soft bend in the arms

name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate at the sides, arms straight in front of your thighs.
Brace your stomach and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the plate straight in front to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to lift the plate
common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter plate and brace
Stop at shoulder height
Lower with control

name: Bent-Over Reverse Dumbbell Fly
steps: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward until your torso is nearly flat, knees soft.
Let the dumbbells hang under your chest, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly back under your chest.
cues: Lift out wide, not up high

common_mistakes.fix: Keep your chest proud and hinge from the hips
Hold your body still and use lighter dumbbells
Keep the elbow angle fixed

name: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit facing the pec deck pad with handles at shoulder height.
Grip the handles with arms straight in front of you.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc.
Return slowly until your hands meet in front.
cues: Breathe out as you pull back

common_mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders down
Pick a weight you can pause with
Keep your chest in contact with the pad

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and cross the cables, holding opposite handles.
Stand in the middle with arms straight in front of you.
Pull your arms out and back to the sides in a wide arc.
Return slowly to the start.
cues: Squeeze the back of the shoulders

common_mistakes.fix: Stand tall and still
Keep a soft, fixed elbow bend
Take two seconds on each return

name: Band Pull Apart
steps: Hold a band with both hands, arms straight in front at shoulder height.
Stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, arms out wide.
Return slowly to the start.
cues: Breathe out as you pull apart

common_mistakes.fix: Keep your neck long and shoulders down
Keep arms nearly straight
Keep ribs down and stomach tight

name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall holding a bar in front of your thighs, hands about shoulder width.
Lift the bar straight up close to your body, leading with the elbows.
Stop when your upper arms are level with your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs.
cues: Bar stays close to your body

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling the bar up to the chin
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when elbows reach shoulder height
Keep hands about shoulder width apart
Use a lighter bar and keep torso still

name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall holding a bar in front of your thighs, hands shoulder width.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower your shoulders slowly.
cues: Shoulders go straight up, not rolled

common_mistakes.fix: Move straight up and down only
Keep arms long; only shoulders move

common_mistakes.mistake: Weight too heavy for full range
common_mistakes.fix: Lighten it so shoulders reach your ears

name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower slowly.

common_mistakes.fix: Move straight up and down only
Lift smoothly and pause at the top
Keep ears over shoulders

name: Band External Rotation
steps: Tie a band at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the band with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm out away from your body, keeping the elbow in.
Return slowly to the start.

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbow drifting away from the side
common_mistakes.fix: Hold a small towel between elbow and body
Keep your chest facing forward
Use a light band and slow reps

name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a bar with palms facing forward, hands shoulder width.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter bar and keep torso still
Keep elbows by your sides
Lower over two to three seconds

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Pick a lighter weight and stand still
Lower to straight arms each rep
Keep upper arms still

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up, turning your palm to face you.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other arm.
Keep alternating arms.
cues: Turn palm up as you curl

common_mistakes.fix: Brace your stomach and stand still
Lower each dumbbell slowly
Keep the upper arm still

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up, keeping palms facing in.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and stay still
Keep wrists straight and firm
Keep upper arms by your sides

name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall holding an EZ bar on the angled grips, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to lift the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the bar and brace your stomach

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows moving forward at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Keep upper arms still
Lower slowly every rep

name: Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with palms facing up.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
cues: Upper arms stay on the pad
Lower slowly, soft elbows at bottom

common_mistakes.mistake: Dropping into a locked elbow at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Stop just short of fully straight

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the upper arms off the pad
common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms pressed into the pad
Use a weight you can lower slowly

name: Machine Bicep Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms facing up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Return slowly, stopping before the weight touches down.

common_mistakes.fix: Line your elbows up with the machine pivot
Control the return
Stay seated and use a lighter weight

name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with legs apart and a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
cues: Upper arm stays on the thigh

common_mistakes.fix: Keep the upper arm still on the thigh
Take two to three seconds down
Lean forward from the hips, back long

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Turn your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cues: Back and head on the bench

common_mistakes.fix: Keep upper arms hanging straight down

common_mistakes.mistake: Weight too heavy for the stretch
common_mistakes.fix: Use lighter dumbbells than standing curls

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the head off the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your head back on the pad

name: Cable Bicep Curl
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing it.
Grip the bar with palms up, hands shoulder width.
Curl the bar up toward your chest, elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to pull the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Stand tall and lighten the weight
Keep upper arms still

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the cable yank the arms down
common_mistakes.fix: Lower with control

name: Rope Cable Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the rope ends with palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders, elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the weight and brace
Keep wrists firm and straight
Lower to straight arms each time

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a bar with palms facing down, hands shoulder width.
Keep elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep wrists in line with forearms
Use less weight than a normal curl
Keep your torso still

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder width.
Lift the bar out over your chest with straight arms.
Lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Keep hands about shoulder width to protect wrists
Keep elbows close to your body
Lower slowly and touch lightly

name: Diamond Push Ups
steps: Place your hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching.
Straighten your legs behind you into a straight line.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close to your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out up

common_mistakes.fix: Brace stomach and squeeze glutes
Keep elbows brushing your sides

common_mistakes.mistake: Too hard to do with good form
common_mistakes.fix: Do them on your knees or on an incline

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it palms down.
Stand tall with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly until forearms are about level with the floor.
cues: Breathe out as you push down

common_mistakes.fix: Keep upper arms still by your sides

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning over the bar to push
common_mistakes.fix: Stand tall and lighten the weight
Stop when forearms are level with the floor

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip the ends with palms facing in.
Stand tall with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the rope down, spreading the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly until forearms are about level with the floor.
cues: Spread the rope at the bottom
Breathe out as you push down

common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows close to your body
Stand tall and use less weight

common_mistakes.mistake: Short reps at the bottom only
common_mistakes.fix: Let forearms come up to level each rep

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head with elbows bent and pointing forward.
Straighten your arms forward and up over your head.
Bend your elbows slowly to return behind your head.
cues: Elbows stay close to your head

common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows pointing forward
Brace your stomach and stand in a split stance
Only the forearms should move

name: Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest, palms facing away.
Tilt your arms back slightly toward your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows shoulder width apart
Move only at the elbows
Take two to three seconds to lower

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands, cupping the top plate.
Lift it over your head with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows pointing up and close in
Brace your stomach, or sit on a bench
Lower slowly to a comfortable depth

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Lift your upper arms level with your torso, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Straighten your arms back until they are fully extended.
Bend your elbows slowly to return.
cues: Upper arms stay still and high

common_mistakes.fix: Keep upper arms level with your back
Use lighter dumbbells and move slowly
Hinge from the hips with a flat back

name: Bench Dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the bench, legs out in front, knees bent.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms.
cues: Stop when upper arms are level
Breathe out as you push up

common_mistakes.fix: Stop when upper arms are level with the floor

common_mistakes.mistake: Hips drifting far from the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your back close to the bench
Point elbows straight behind you

name: Triceps Dips
steps: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows to lower until upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Breathe out as you push up

common_mistakes.fix: Stop when upper arms are level with the floor
Press shoulders down at the start of each rep
Keep legs still; use the assisted machine

name: Seated Dip Machine
steps: Adjust the seat and sit back with handles at your sides.
Grip the handles with elbows bent and close to your body.
Push the handles down until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly to the start.
cues: Breathe out as you push down

common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows tucked in
Stay seated and lower the weight
Control the return

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells, forearms resting on your thighs, palms up.
Let your wrists hang just past your knees.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Lower slowly back down.

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the forearms off the thighs
common_mistakes.fix: Keep forearms pressed down
Use a light weight and full range
Pause at the top of each rep

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells, forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Let your hands hang just past your knees.
Lift the backs of your hands up as high as you can.
Lower slowly back down.

common_mistakes.fix: Go light; this muscle is small
Keep forearms still on the thighs
Lift and lower slowly

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack just below shoulder height and load it.
Step under, rest the bar on your upper back and grip it just wider than your shoulders.
Stand up to lift it off, take two small steps back, feet shoulder width.
Push hips back and bend knees to lower until thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand tall, then repeat.
cues: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Squat only as deep as your back stays flat
Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.mistake: Knees cave inward on the way up
common_mistakes.fix: Push knees out in line with your toes
Sit hips back and keep weight over mid-foot and heels

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back rounds at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Stop just above that depth and brace your stomach first

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the handle sides close to your chest.
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between your knees, keeping elbows inside the knees.
Lower until thighs are about parallel or as low as your back stays flat.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
cues: Weight held tight to your chest
Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.mistake: Weight drifts away from the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the bell touching your chest the whole rep
Lift your chest and look straight ahead
Spread the floor with your feet and push knees out

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, toes slightly out.
Reach your arms forward or cross them on your chest.
Push hips back and bend knees to sit down slowly.
Go as low as you can while keeping your back flat.
Press through your heels to stand up tall.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.mistake: Heels lift as you go down
common_mistakes.fix: Sit back more and keep weight on your heels
Take two to three seconds to lower
Push knees out in line with your toes

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad.
Place feet shoulder width in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly toward your chest.
Stop before your hips lift, then press back up without locking knees.
Lock the safeties back in place when you finish.
cues: Lower back stays on the pad
Soft knees at the top, never locked
Breathe in down, breathe out as you press

common_mistakes.mistake: Hips roll up off the seat at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Shorten the range so your lower back stays down

common_mistakes.mistake: Locking the knees hard at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Stop just short of straight
Keep knees pointing the same way as your toes

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs, hands just outside your legs.
Feet hip width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, usually just below the knee.
Squeeze your glutes and drive hips forward to stand tall.
cues: Bar stays close to your legs
Soft knees, same bend all rep
Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach lower
common_mistakes.fix: Stop where your back starts to round

common_mistakes.mistake: Bar drifts away from the legs
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the bar brushing your thighs
Keep a small fixed knee bend and push hips back

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Set feet hip width apart with a small bend in the knees.
Push hips back and slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch and your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
cues: Hips back like closing a door
Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.fix: Lower only as far as you can keep it flat
Keep knees soft and push hips back instead
Stand tall and squeeze glutes, no backward lean

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a long step forward with one leg.
Bend both knees until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front heel to rise and bring the back foot forward.
Step straight into the next lunge with the other leg.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Steps too short so the knee shoots forward
common_mistakes.fix: Take a longer step
Keep shoulders over hips
Line the front knee up with your second toe

name: Dumbbell Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg about two feet.
Lower until both knees are bent near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to step back to standing.
Switch legs or finish all reps on one side first.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you push back

common_mistakes.fix: Lower under control and stop just above
Keep chest up and eyes ahead

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet in one line, losing balance
common_mistakes.fix: Keep feet hip width apart, like train tracks

name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Set the shin pad just above your ankles and knees in line with the pivot.
Hold the side handles.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad until knees are nearly straight.
Pause, then lower slowly to the start.
cues: Knees line up with the machine pivot

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and lift smoothly
Hold the handles and stay seated
Control the lowering all the way

name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on the machine, knees just off the bench edge.
Set the pad just above your heels and hold the handles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes as far as you comfortably can.
Pause and squeeze the back of your thighs.
Lower slowly until legs are nearly straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the load and keep hips pressed down
Lower until legs are nearly straight each rep
Lift with control and pause at the top

name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and knees lined up with the pivot.
Place the lower pad behind your ankles and lock the thigh pad down.
Hold the handles and press your heels down and back.
Bend knees as far as comfortable, then pause.
Let the pad rise slowly back to the start.
cues: Thigh pad snug on your legs
Squeeze the back of your thighs

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning forward to pull the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Stay back on the pad, use a lighter weight
Return slowly over two seconds
Lower it so your thighs cannot lift

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench edge.
Roll a padded barbell over your hips and hold it in place.
Bend your knees and set feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift hips until your body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower hips under control.
cues: Breathe out as you drive up

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when hips are level and squeeze glutes
Move feet so shins are vertical at the top
Drive through your heels

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip width apart.
Rest your arms by your sides, palms down.
Press through your heels to lift your hips off the floor.
Stop when knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line.
Hold one second, then lower slowly.

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back to go higher
common_mistakes.fix: Stop at a straight line and squeeze glutes
Keep knees hip width, in line with feet
Pause one second at the top

name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
steps: Set the shoulder pads to your height and step under them.
Place the balls of your feet on the block, heels hanging off.
Stand up straight with a slight bend in the knees.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and pause.
Lower your heels slowly below the block for a stretch.
cues: Rise high onto the big toe
Pause one second at the top

common_mistakes.fix: Pause briefly at the bottom of each rep
Keep the knees fixed, only the ankles move
Go from full stretch to full rise

name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the footrest.
Set the knee pad snug on your lower thighs.
Lift the pad slightly and release the safety lever.
Lower your heels slowly for a stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Reset the safety lever when done.
cues: Balls of the feet on the edge

common_mistakes.fix: Pause one second at the stretch
Lower heels fully, then rise fully

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet slipping back on the rest
common_mistakes.fix: Keep only the balls of your feet on the edge

name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Set feet shoulder width apart, toes slightly out.
Push hips back and bend knees to lower down.
Stop when thighs are about parallel or your back starts to round.
Press through your heels to stand.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning forward with a round back
common_mistakes.fix: Lift your chest and look straight ahead
Keep weight in your heels and mid-foot
Push knees out over your toes

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand about two steps in front of a bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the top of your back foot on the bench behind you.
Bend your front knee to lower your body straight down.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to rise. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: Torso tall, slight forward lean is fine
Front knee in line with toes
Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Front foot too close to the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Step further out so the front shin stays upright
Back leg only balances, front leg does the work
Keep the knee over your second toe

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back about two feet.
Bend both knees until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front heel to bring the back foot forward.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you return

common_mistakes.fix: Take a longer step back
Keep the torso upright
Drive up through the front heel

name: Dumbbell Step Up
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your whole right foot on the box.
Push through the right heel to stand up on the box.
Step down slowly with the left foot, then the right.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.
cues: Breathe out as you step up

common_mistakes.fix: Keep the back foot light, lift with the top leg
Pick a height where your knee is at or below hip level

common_mistakes.mistake: Knee caves in on the way up
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the knee in line with your toes

name: Hack Squat
steps: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Set feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Straighten your legs and release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower until thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to rise without locking the knees.
Re-engage the safeties when done.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you press

common_mistakes.fix: Move feet slightly higher on the platform
Shorten the depth to keep your back flat
Stop just short of straight

name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your upper back.
Place feet shoulder width, slightly in front of the bar.
Stand up and twist the bar to unhook it.
Bend hips and knees to lower until thighs are about parallel.
Press up through your heels, then rehook the bar when done.
cues: Feet slightly forward of the bar
Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.fix: Step feet a little forward for balance

common_mistakes.mistake: Forgetting to set the safety stops
common_mistakes.fix: Set them just below your bottom position
Push knees out over your toes

name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at upper chest height.
Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders, fingertips under it, elbows high.
Lift it off and step back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit straight down between your knees until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your feet, keeping elbows high.
cues: Bar rests on shoulders, not hands
Breathe in and brace before each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows drop and the bar rolls forward
common_mistakes.fix: Lift elbows high throughout

common_mistakes.mistake: Gripping the bar tightly in the palms
common_mistakes.fix: Use loose fingertips; the shoulders hold it
Sit down, not forward; widen stance a little

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell by its end with both hands, arms straight.
Stand with feet wider than shoulders, toes turned out.
Bend knees and lower straight down, keeping your chest up.
Stop when thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand and squeeze your inner thighs.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.fix: Push knees out in the direction of your toes
Keep the chest tall and weight between your feet
Let it hang still from straight arms

name: Dumbbell Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Set feet shoulder width apart, toes slightly out.
Push hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Do not sit down or relax on it.
Press through your heels to stand back up.
cues: Tap the bench, do not sit
Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.fix: Lower slowly and just touch it
Drive up through your heels
Use a height you can reach with a flat back

name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs, hands shoulder width.
Keep your knees almost straight with a slight bend.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch with your back still flat.
Squeeze glutes and hamstrings to stand back up.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Stop where your back stays flat
Keep a slight bend in the knees
Start light; this stretches hamstrings under load

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the same-side leg.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip, lowering the bell as the free leg reaches back.
Stop when your torso is near parallel or your back starts to round.
Squeeze the standing glute to return upright. Switch sides after the set.
cues: Hips stay square to the floor
Free leg in line with your body
Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Hip of the free leg opens up
common_mistakes.fix: Point the back toes at the floor
Hold a rack with your free hand until steady
Lower only as far as your back stays flat

name: Cable Pull Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Straddle the cable and hold the rope between your legs.
Walk forward a few steps, feet wider than hips.
Push hips back and let the rope pass between your legs.
Drive hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms straight and drive with the hips
Push hips back with only a small knee bend
Finish tall with glutes squeezed

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Sit on the floor with a padded barbell over your legs.
Roll the bar over your hips and lie back on the floor.
Bend your knees and set feet flat, hip width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips and the bar.
Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
cues: Hold the bar steady over your hips

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Stop at a straight line from knees to shoulders
Use a bar pad or folded mat for comfort

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet too close or too far
common_mistakes.fix: Set feet so shins are vertical at the top

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one foot and hold that knee in toward your chest or straight up.
Press through the heel on the floor to lift your hips.
Pause with hips level at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

common_mistakes.fix: Lift lower and keep both hip bones level
Press down through the heel
Keep ribs down and stop at a straight line

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or plate, heels off.
Lower your heels slowly for a stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
cues: Rise high onto the big toe

common_mistakes.fix: Pause at the bottom and top
Press through the big toe
Hold one dumbbell and steady yourself with the other hand

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place a step or plate under a Smith bar set at shoulder height.
Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with balls of feet on the step.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with soft knees.
Lower your heels slowly, then rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then rehook the bar when done.

common_mistakes.fix: Pause one second at the stretch
Only the ankles move
Use a stable block that cannot slide

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit in the leg press and press the platform up with legs straight but not locked.
Keep the safety handles locked if your machine allows it.
Move your feet so only the balls of your feet are on the lower edge.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Lower slowly until your calves stretch.
cues: Balls of feet on the edge

common_mistakes.fix: Keep legs straight and still; only ankles move
Use a lighter load and set feet carefully
Use the full range with a pause at the top

name: Donkey Kicks
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Keep one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Lift that leg up behind you, sole toward the ceiling.
Stop when your thigh is level with your back and squeeze.
Lower slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the top
Hips stay square to the floor

common_mistakes.fix: Lift only to thigh level and brace your stomach
Lift slowly and pause at the top
Keep both hips pointing at the floor

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for support.
Lean forward slightly with a soft bend in the standing knee.
Kick the strapped leg back until you feel your glute squeeze.
Return slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Move from the hip, not the back

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching the back to kick higher
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when the glute is fully squeezed
Use less weight and move slowly
Keep hips square to the machine

name: Band Standing Kickback
steps: Tie a band low on a post and loop the other end around one ankle.
Face the post and hold it for balance.
Stand tall with your stomach braced.
Push the banded leg straight back, keeping the knee straight.
Return slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the back

common_mistakes.fix: Keep chest up and take a smaller range
Brace your stomach and stop at the squeeze
Return slowly against the pull

name: Banded Monster Walk
steps: Place a mini band just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with feet shoulder width so the band is tight.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Take small steps forward diagonally, keeping tension on the band.
Walk the same number of steps backward to the start.
cues: Stay low in a quarter squat
Knees push out against the band

common_mistakes.fix: Stay in a quarter squat throughout
Keep feet apart so the band stays tight
Push knees outward against the band

name: Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit in the machine with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Hold the handles and sit tall against the back pad.
Push your knees apart as far as is comfortable.
Pause and squeeze the sides of your hips.
Let the legs come back together slowly.

common_mistakes.fix: Control the return all the way
Sit tall and keep your upper body still

common_mistakes.mistake: Weight too heavy for full range
common_mistakes.fix: Lighten it so you can open fully

name: Hip Adduction Machine
steps: Sit in the machine with the pads on the inside of your knees.
Set the start width to a gentle stretch, not a forced one.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Squeeze your knees together until the pads meet.
Open your legs slowly back to the start.

common_mistakes.fix: Begin at a mild stretch only
Squeeze smoothly and pause
Hold the handles and stay still

name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and put it on the leg nearer the machine.
Step away sideways until the cable is tight and hold the frame.
Stand on the far leg with the strapped leg slightly out to the side.
Sweep the strapped leg across in front of your standing leg.
Return slowly. Finish the set, then switch sides.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning the body to swing the leg
common_mistakes.fix: Keep your torso upright and still
Use a load you can move smoothly

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the cable yank the leg out

name: Band Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Tie a band low on a post and stand side-on, the post at your left.

name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on top of an exercise ball.

name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Set the machine to your height and place one leg under the ankle pad.

name: Barbell Lunge
steps: Set a bar in a rack just below shoulder height and rest it on your upper back.

Step forward with one leg and lower until the back knee is near the floor.
Push through the front heel to step back to the start.

name: Lateral Lunge

name: Barbell Box Squat

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat

name: Resistance Band Squat

name: Step Up with Knee Drive

name: Barbell Good Morning
steps: Rest a light barbell on your upper back as you would for a squat.

name: Band Good Morning

name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.

name: Box Jump
steps: Stand about a foot in front of a sturdy, low box.

name: Skater Jumps

name: Tuck Jump

name: Plank

name: Crunches

name: Bicycle Crunch

name: Lying Leg Raise

name: Cable Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.

name: Barbell Deadlift

name: Trap Bar Deadlift

name: Kettlebell Swing

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the bell with the arms
common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms loose and let the hip snap move the bell
Push hips back with only a soft bend in the knees
Finish standing straight with glutes and stomach tight

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders and body in a straight line.
Drive one knee towards your chest, keeping the other leg straight.
Switch legs, sending the bent leg back as the other knee comes in.
Keep alternating at a steady pace you can control.

common_mistakes.fix: Lower the hips until the body is one straight line
Keep shoulders stacked over your wrists

common_mistakes.mistake: Going so fast the form falls apart
common_mistakes.fix: Slow down and make each knee drive clean

name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Stand between two heavy dumbbells and grip them firmly.
Bend knees and hips, keep your back flat and stand up with the weights.
Walk forward with short, steady steps, arms straight by your sides.
Keep walking for the set time, then stop and lower the weights with a flat back.
cues: Stand tall, shoulders back and down
Stomach tight, don't lean to one side

common_mistakes.mistake: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
common_mistakes.fix: Pull shoulders down and keep the neck long

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to pick up or put down
common_mistakes.fix: Bend at hips and knees with a flat back, like a deadlift
Take short, quick steps and keep the weights still

name: Rowing Machine
steps: Sit on the rower, strap your feet in and hold the handle with straight arms.
Slide forward with knees bent and shins near vertical, body leaning slightly forward.
Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms out, lean forward from the hips, then bend the knees.
Keep a smooth, steady rhythm for the set time.
cues: Elbows close, handle to lower ribs
Breathe out as you push back

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling with the arms before the legs push
common_mistakes.fix: Keep arms straight until the legs are nearly flat

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the front
common_mistakes.fix: Lean from the hips with a tall chest
Drive hard, then come forward slowly

name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Hold two kettlebells at your shoulders, elbows tucked, feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up to a depth where your back stays flat.
Drive up out of the squat and use that push to press both bells overhead.
Lock your arms out with the bells over your head, then lower them to your shoulders.
Flow straight into the next squat.
cues: Elbows close, chest up in the squat
Legs start the press, arms finish it
Breathe in down, breathe out as you press

common_mistakes.fix: Stand up fast and let the leg drive move the bells
Squeeze glutes and stomach and keep ribs down

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows dropping and chest folding in the squat
common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows up in front and use lighter bells

name: Dumbbell Swing
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than hips, holding one dumbbell by its end with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and let the dumbbell swing back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall so the dumbbell swings up to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again to meet it, keeping your back flat.
cues: Hinge at the hips, soft knees
Hips move the weight, arms stay loose
Breathe out as you snap up

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the dumbbell with the shoulders
common_mistakes.fix: Let the hip snap do the work and keep arms relaxed

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Push hips back and keep the chest lifted

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging too high and arching back
common_mistakes.fix: Stop at chest height and finish with glutes tight

name: Battle Ropes
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand and step back until the rope has a little slack.
Stand with feet shoulder width, knees bent and hips back in a half squat.
Raise and drop your arms one after the other to send waves down the rope.
Keep the waves going for the set time, then stand up and rest.
cues: Quick, small waves from the shoulders

common_mistakes.mistake: Standing up straight with locked knees
common_mistakes.fix: Stay in a half squat so the legs help absorb the work
Keep the chest up and shoulders away from the ears
Step closer to the anchor and keep the arm action steady

name: Medicine Ball Slam
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width, holding a slam ball in both hands at your waist.
Lift the ball overhead and rise up tall.
Slam the ball into the floor just in front of your feet, bending hips and knees.
Squat down with a flat back, pick up the ball and stand to start the next rep.
cues: Hips and knees bend as you throw
Flat back when picking the ball up
Breathe out hard on the slam

common_mistakes.mistake: Bending only at the waist to slam
common_mistakes.fix: Bend hips and knees together so the legs share the work

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to pick the ball up
common_mistakes.fix: Squat down to the ball with a flat back

common_mistakes.mistake: Using a ball that bounces back at the face
common_mistakes.fix: Use a dead-bounce slam ball and slam it near your feet

name: Skipping Rope
steps: Hold a handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels.
Turn the rope over your head using your wrists, elbows close to your sides.
Jump just high enough for the rope to pass under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and keep a steady rhythm for the set time.
cues: Land on the balls of your feet
Turn from the wrists, elbows in

common_mistakes.fix: Lift the feet only a few centimetres off the floor
Stay on the balls of the feet with soft knees

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging the rope with the whole arm
common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows by your sides and turn from the wrists

name: Star Jumps
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width and arms by your sides.
Bend into a quarter squat with your chest up.
Jump up and spread your arms and legs wide like a star.
Bring arms and legs back in before landing and land softly in a quarter squat.
cues: Arms and legs open at the top

common_mistakes.fix: Bend the knees as you land to absorb the impact
Push the knees out in line with the toes

common_mistakes.mistake: Landing with legs still wide apart
common_mistakes.fix: Bring the feet back under the hips before touching down

name: Inchworm
steps: Stand with feet together and fold forward to put your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward one at a time until you reach a high plank.
Hold the plank for a moment with your body in a straight line.
Walk your feet in small steps towards your hands, then roll up to stand.
cues: Bend the knees as much as you need
Hands under shoulders at the end

common_mistakes.mistake: Forcing straight legs and rounding hard
common_mistakes.fix: Bend the knees enough to reach the floor comfortably
Squeeze glutes and stomach to keep a straight line

common_mistakes.mistake: Walking the hands too far out
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when your hands are under your shoulders

name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, shins close to the bar.
Bend your knees and hinge to grip the bar inside your legs, arms straight down.
Push your knees out, flatten your back and lift your chest.
Drive the floor apart with your feet and stand up tall with the bar close.
Sit the hips back and lower the bar to the floor under control.
cues: Knees pushed out over the toes
Bar stays close to your body
Big breath and brace before each lift

common_mistakes.fix: Push the knees out in line with your toes the whole lift

common_mistakes.mistake: Hips rising before the bar moves
common_mistakes.fix: Sit a little lower and lift chest and hips together

common_mistakes.mistake: Stance so wide the hips feel pinched
common_mistakes.fix: Bring feet in until you can reach depth comfortably

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie on your back, press the bell up with one arm and bend the knee on that side.
Push through that foot and roll onto your free elbow, then onto your free hand.
Lift your hips, sweep the straight leg back under you into a half-kneel.
Lift your torso upright and stand up from the lunge, arm locked out overhead.
Reverse every step slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.
cues: Arm locked, eyes on the bell
Shoulder pulled down into its socket
Move slowly, one step at a time

common_mistakes.mistake: Bent elbow letting the bell drift
common_mistakes.fix: Lock the arm straight and keep the bell over the shoulder
Pause at each position before moving on
Learn it with a shoe or light bell first

name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Hold two kettlebells at your shoulders, elbows tucked, feet hip width.
Dip a few centimetres by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up hard through your legs and press both bells overhead.
Lock your arms out overhead, then lower the bells back to your shoulders.
cues: Heels stay down in the dip
Breathe in at the dip, out as you press

common_mistakes.mistake: Dipping too deep like a squat
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the dip short, just a quarter bend of the knees

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back and arching the lower back
common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and stomach, ribs down

common_mistakes.mistake: Pressing before the legs finish driving
common_mistakes.fix: Let the leg drive start the bells moving, then press

name: Sled Push
steps: Load the sled and grip the upright handles with your arms extended.
Lean into the sled so your body forms a straight line from head to back foot.
Drive forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep pushing for the set time, then stop and rest.

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back over the handles
common_mistakes.fix: Lean from the ankles with a straight back and flat neck
Take short, quick steps under your hips

common_mistakes.mistake: Loading it so heavy it barely moves
common_mistakes.fix: Use a load you can push at a steady walk or faster
